Provide $50 of liquidity to GoonFi's deepest pool on Solana, and keep the position in range instead of chasing the highest-fee pool. Cost: $50 of capital and about $3 of gas. Time: 15 to 20 minutes.
Once a week, rebalance GoonFi's pool position if it has left its range, or add a small amount of liquidity to the same pool. Cost: about $2 to $5 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Keep at least $50 in the position for 90 days: a points snapshot usually follows activity across several weeks, not a single deposit. Cost: the $50 stays at work. Time: 90 days.

Watch GoonFi's own site, docs and governance forum for a points or token announcement, check eligibility from that page only, and never pay a wallet or a third party to claim. Cost: no fee to check; never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Before you enter, check GoonFi's withdrawal rules, fees and any lock-up on Solana, and keep a small liquid reserve outside the position. Cost: no fee unless the vault or asset charges one. Time: 15 minutes.

Record the wallet address, every deposit date, the gas paid and the position's value in a farm log, and re-check the position whenever the model's category multiple changes. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.
